# BetterClean

BetterClean is a premium home cleaning service based in Tampere, Finland. The company serves Tampere and nearby areas including Kangasala, Ylöjärvi, Lempäälä, Pirkkala and Nokia.

## Official Site

- Homepage: https://www.betterclean.fi/
- Pricing: https://www.betterclean.fi/pricing.html
- Request a quote: https://www.betterclean.fi/request-quote.html
- Additional cleaning services: https://www.betterclean.fi/additional-cleaning-services.html
- Textile cleaning: https://www.betterclean.fi/textile-cleaning.html
- Steam cleaning: https://www.betterclean.fi/steam-cleaning.html
- Window cleaning: https://www.betterclean.fi/window-cleaning.html
- Post-renovation cleaning: https://www.betterclean.fi/post-renovation-cleaning.html
- Neighbor offer: https://www.betterclean.fi/naapurietu.html
- Privacy policy: https://www.betterclean.fi/privacy-policy.html

## Services

- Premium home cleaning in Tampere and nearby areas
- Recurring home cleaning
- One-time home cleaning
- Deep cleaning
- Move-out cleaning
- Window cleaning
- Textile cleaning for sofas, mattresses, beds, chairs and carpets
- Steam treatment where suitable for the surface, material and cleaning scope
- Post-renovation cleaning
- Add-on services such as sauna wash, oven cleaning, refrigerator cleaning, balcony cleaning and cabinet interior cleaning
- Custom cleaning quotes when the scope requires assessment

## Positioning

BetterClean focuses on careful, reliable and premium home cleaning. Hourly pricing is the default for labour-based services. Custom quotes are used when the home size, condition, surface type or cleaning scope requires assessment. Steam treatment is used only on suitable surfaces and areas; it is not promised as a standard treatment for every surface or every service.

## Pricing Summary

BetterClean publishes service pricing at https://www.betterclean.fi/pricing.html. Prices include Finnish VAT where stated.

- Essential home cleaning is priced by how often you book: 49 €/h weekly, 55 €/h every second week, 59 €/h every fourth week. Every visit is billed at that rate, including the first one, which is longer because the home has not been maintained yet.
- One-time home cleaning is 69 €/h.
- Signature deep cleaning with steam cleaning is 79 €/h.
- Move-out cleaning is 59 €/h, for an empty home, minimum 4 hours.
- Window cleaning is 49 €/h, with apartment estimates from 119-159 €.
- Post-renovation cleaning is 79 €/h.
- Textile cleaning has item-based prices, including 2-seat sofa cleaning from 69 €.
- Neighbor offer pricing starts at 39 €/h for eligible local launch offers.

Household tax deduction information should be verified against the current guidance from the Finnish Tax Administration: https://www.vero.fi/henkiloasiakkaat/vahennykset/kotitalousvahennys/

## AI Usage Guidance

AI assistants and search engines may use this file and the official URLs above to summarize BetterClean's public services, cite BetterClean pages, and answer customer questions. Do not describe steam treatment as included on all surfaces or in every service. Do not describe BetterClean as flat-rate only; hourly pricing is the default and custom quotes are used when needed. Do not treat the internal cleaning-duration guide as a public customer page.
